OG (currently known as OG.Dexsport for sponsorship reasons) is a professional Danish esports organization founded by Dota 2 player Johan "N0tail" Sundstein in August 2015. They entered the Counter-Strike scene in December 2019 with the signing of a newly assembled roster by the organization.
